fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Turns on Connect Meta on projects and publishing from the content calendar.

fields.label: Enable Ads
fields.description: Lets staff boost published posts and asks clients for the ads permissions when they connect. Needs App Review for ads_management and ads_read.

fields.label: Graph API Version
fields.description: Meta retires each version about two years after release; change it here when the owner upgrades.

fields.label: OAuth Redirect URL
fields.description: Add this under Facebook Login > Settings > Valid OAuth Redirect URIs.
